verdict.rationale: The privacy page says chat data is stored locally on the client by default, with cloud sync optional. Self-hosting via Docker Compose, the 'privacy-first' local desktop app and user-editable agent memory also imply some user control over where data lives. No evidence documents explicit retention or deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented data deletion or account-wipe controls, configurable retention periods, deletion guarantees for cloud-synced data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
